addNode.title: Add a node
addNode.intro: Generate a single-use join token, then start the node daemon with it. The token expires in 15 minutes.
addNode.downloadHint: Download the archive for this machine (fleetdeck-node_<version>_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz, .zip on Windows) and verify it against SHA256SUMS. Linux, macOS, and Windows on amd64/arm64 are published for every tag.
addNode.onceBody: It is shown only once and can register exactly one node.
addNode.commandHint: The hub URL and the token travel as flags (--hub-url, --join-token) — no environment variables. The token is single-use and is never written to disk.
addNode.defaultConfigHint: Without --config the daemon uses the platform config directory and creates the file when missing: ~/.config/fleetdeck/node.yaml on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/fleetdeck/node.yaml on macOS, %AppData%\fleetdeck\node.yaml on Windows (XDG_CONFIG_HOME is honored when set). The issued credential lives beside it (Linux: ~/.local/state/fleetdeck/node-token, Windows: %LocalAppData%\fleetdeck\node-token). Pick the agents it offers with `fleetdeck-node config` (re-run it after installing a new agent CLI).
addNode.persistHint: hub_url is written into that file after the first successful registration, so later starts need no flags.
addNode.step2: Run fleetdeck-node config to pick the agents this machine offers.
addNode.error: Could not create a join token
